findings.evidence: component-gallery.css:503-509 (.dialog { display:flex } with no .dialog[hidden] rule) vs only .sheet[hidden]/#evidence-panel[hidden] rules at css:477,581; live eval: after Escape/scrim/Cancel — {dialogHiddenAttr:true, display:'flex', w:324, h:194, visible:true}; dialogCancelVisible:true; same in RTL
findings.criterion: Dialog-out close path; Escape closes the top layer; focus never lost; every overlay has exactly one obvious close path
findings.finding: The dialog NEVER visually closes. The author rule display:flex overrides the user-agent [hidden]{display:none} rule, so hidden=true leaves the dialog fully rendered and interactive on top of the screen. Focus also remains on the 'closed' dialog's Cancel button. The verification-report (line 55) marked close as PASS by checking the hidden attribute only.
findings.recommendation: Add '.dialog[hidden], .snackbar[hidden] { display: none; }' to component-gallery.css (or drive open state with a class instead of the hidden attribute). Re-verify closes with getBoundingClientRect/offsetParent, not attribute reads.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.css:518-524 (.snackbar { display:flex }, no [hidden] rule); live eval after 5s timer: {after5s_hiddenAttr:true, display:'flex', visible:true, rect:[254,68]}; undo click then re-shows it with a new message
findings.criterion: Snackbar 5s auto-dismiss then disappear; quiet feedback layer; undo affordance for reversible actions
findings.finding: The snackbar never visually dismisses. After the 5000ms timer sets hidden=true, the element remains rendered forever (display:flex overrides [hidden]). Once any snackbar is fired, a snackbar is permanently on screen — the 'Record deleted' prompt with a live Undo button stays visible indefinitely, misrepresenting the 5s contract and the one-snackbar-replaces-old semantics.
findings.recommendation: Same CSS fix as S3-01; then implement the documented enter (300ms snackbarIn) and exit (300ms + 250ms delay) so dismissal is visible and graceful.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.js:181-188 — openOverlay() begins with overlayClose(), which focuses openTrigger then sets openTrigger=null; the click handlers assign openTrigger at js:191/198 BEFORE calling openOverlay, so it is always null when a close later runs; live: sheet Escape → activeElement=BODY, isTrigger:false; dialog Escape → focus stays on the closed dialog's Cancel
findings.criterion: Focus containment + restore to trigger on close; focus never lost (run authority keyboard/focus rules; motion-interaction.md:26; overlay-system.md:20)
findings.finding: Focus restore on overlay close is completely broken. Closing a sheet drops focus to BODY (focus lost — keyboard users must re-Tab from the page start); closing the dialog leaves focus on the invisible dialog control. The documented 'focus returns to the trigger' behavior is documented-but-not-implemented (the code attempts it but the trigger reference is nulled during open).
findings.recommendation: Set openTrigger AFTER overlayClose() inside openOverlay (e.g. openOverlay(el, screen, trigger)), or store the trigger in openOverlay and have overlayClose consume it. Also refocus the trigger in the [data-close-overlay] and scrim paths (they share overlayClose, so one fix covers all).

findings.evidence: Live computed styles: .sheet/.dialog/.scrim/.snackbar/.menu all report transition 'all 0s ease' and animation 'none'; keyframes slideUp/slideDown/fadeIn/scaleIn/snackbarIn defined at design-tokens.css:293-300 are referenced nowhere in component-gallery.css (grep: no matches); docs claims at motion-interaction.md:34 (scrim 200ms, sheet 340ms, dialog 200ms scaleIn, snackbar 300ms), overlay-system.md:16,24,28,36
findings.criterion: Sheet entry/exit, scrim, dialog-in/out, snackbar/menu motion with measured timings; 'Motion layer must be demonstrable in the offline gallery'
findings.finding: ALL overlay motion is documented but not implemented. The gallery's overlays (sheet, dialog, scrim, snackbar, select menu) appear and disappear instantly. The motion-interaction.md 'Overlay choreography' section and overlay-system.md motion rows are false for the shipped gallery; the verification report never asserted transitions. This is the single largest gap between documentation and behavior in the package.
findings.recommendation: Wire the existing keyframes/tokens: sheet — animation slideUp var(--motion-sheet) var(--ease-standard) on open, slideDown on close (requires a closing class before display:none); dialog — scaleIn var(--motion-fast); scrim — transition opacity var(--motion-fast); snackbar — snackbarIn var(--motion-base), exit translateY+opacity 300ms with the 250ms JS delay; menu — fadeIn/scaleIn var(--motion-fast). Keep durations tokenized so the timing system can be re-tuned in one place.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.html:488-501 — the only sheet is an 'Add record' action sheet (title field + 3 action rows); no Filter trigger control, no grouped choice groups, no Apply/Reset/Cancel row, no staged state, no active-count badge anywhere in the gallery
findings.criterion: Required behavior C: one compact Filter control (+ optional active-count) opening a Bottom Sheet with scrim, handle, clear title, grouped choices (status/date range/type/sort), Apply/Reset; selections staged until Apply; cancel without committing; post-apply active summary in parent
findings.finding: The staged filter sheet — a required behavior with explicit commit semantics — is missing entirely. The gallery demonstrates only an inline single-select chip row and a 'Clear filters' action, which cannot show staging, cancel-without-commit, or parent-side active summary.
findings.recommendation: Add a Filter composition: compact filter trigger with active-count chip → bottom sheet (scrim, handle, 'Filters' title, grouped single/multi choices for status/date-range/type/sort) with a sticky action row [Reset | Apply]; stage selections in JS state, commit on Apply (update trigger label + count), discard on Cancel/scrim/Escape; snackbar-free (the count is the proof).

findings.evidence: component-gallery.js:236-240 — the undo handler hides the snackbar and fires a second snackbar 'Deletion reversed'; no data model exists; captures/behavior-undo.txt records only the message swap
findings.criterion: Undo affordance for reversible actions — no toast-only proof for important outcomes; undo that actually restores state, not a message swap
findings.finding: Undo is a message swap with no state behind it. Nothing is deleted when 'Record deleted' fires, so nothing is restored by Undo — the demo cannot prove the soft-delete + undo pattern the docs describe (motion-interaction.md:46, overlay-system.md:36).
findings.recommendation: Pair the snackbar demo with a small live list: delete removes a row locally (with ghostOut removal animation), Undo re-inserts it at the same index (with an insert highlight), and the row count updates — outcome proof beyond the toast.

findings.evidence: No scroll-snap / snap-point / next-item-cue code in CSS or JS (grep scroll-snap|rail|cue: zero matches); the only horizontal scrollers are .chip-row (css:249-253) and .segctl-lines (css:303), both plain overflow-x:auto
findings.criterion: Required behavior G: horizontal QuickActionRail or segmented horizontal control with touch drag, proximity snap, visible next-item cue, and NO accidental vertical scroll hijack
findings.finding: No horizontal rail with snapping exists. The chip row and underline tabs scroll freely with no snap points, no proximity behavior, no edge cue indicating more items (no fade/peek affordance), so the required rail interaction cannot be evaluated in the gallery.
findings.recommendation: Add a QuickActionRail demo: horizontally scrollable action cards with scroll-snap-type:x proximity, snap-align:center, a visible next-item peek (partial card at the inline edge), overscroll-behavior to prevent vertical hijack, and press feedback per card.

findings.evidence: ghostOut keyframe defined at design-tokens.css:300 but referenced nowhere (grep ghostOut in component-gallery.css: no matches); no row insertion/removal/update demonstration exists; component-contracts.md:67 claims 'ghost-out removal animation for dismissed items'; motion-interaction.md:13 claims 'ghost-card collapse' at 300ms
findings.criterion: Required behavior G: local row insertion/update/removal feedback WITHOUT page-wide sliding
findings.finding: Local row mutation feedback is documented (ghostOut) but not implemented and not demonstrated; there is no interaction in the gallery that adds, updates, or removes a row.
findings.recommendation: Wire ghostOut (300ms, height+opacity collapse, no transform on siblings) to a row-dismiss interaction in the sheet or list demo, plus a subtle insert highlight (background-color fade) for additions — both local, no page-level movement.

findings.evidence: No progress/relationship bar exists in the gallery (grep progress: only tag/badge classes tag-progress at html:260,306); no animated fill element, no numeric-final-value pattern
findings.criterion: Required behavior G: progress/relationship bar movement when meaning changes, with final numeric values appearing immediately
findings.finding: The progress/relationship bar behavior is entirely absent — no component, no motion, no immediate-numbers demonstration (which is also the counter-proof for the count-up prohibition).
findings.recommendation: Add a compact progress bar demo (e.g. budget used) whose fill transitions width at --motion-normal when the value changes, while the numeric label (mono tabular) jumps to the final value immediately — no count-up.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.js:171-177 — overlayClose touches only sheet/dialog/scrim; live: Escape with menu open leaves it open (menuStillOpen:true); click on another field leaves it open (afterOutsideClick_menuHidden:false); focus never moves into the menu (focusInMenu:false after Enter-open); overlay-system.md:28 claims 'closes on outside touch or Escape. Same focus containment.'
findings.criterion: Menu dismissibility and focus contract (overlay-system.md §Menu; keyboard operability)
findings.finding: The select menu ignores Escape and outside clicks, and does not manage focus into the listbox; the documented close paths are not implemented. Keyboard users can still reach options via Tab (they are buttons), so it is operable but non-conforming to its own contract.
findings.recommendation: Include the menu in the Escape handler and add a document-level pointerdown-outside close; move focus to the first option (or selected option) on open, restore to the trigger on close; add Arrow-key movement for the listbox pattern.

findings.evidence: No env(safe-area-inset-*) in component-gallery.css/html (grep env(: only design-tokens.css:247-248 utilities, unused in the gallery); live: sheet computed paddingBottom 0px, sheet-body bottom 32px fixed; .bottomnav padding 8px 12px 16px (css:437); .actionbar padding 12px 16px (css:460); responsive-geometry.md:26 claims five safe-area surfaces
findings.criterion: Safe area: sheet/actionbar/nav respect env(safe-area-inset-*) (run authority); overlay-system.md:18 'bottom inset padding'
findings.finding: Safe-area insets are claimed on five surfaces but applied on none of the gallery's live components — only dormant utility classes exist. A device with insets would clip the sheet's last row and the nav labels.
findings.recommendation: Apply .safe-area-bottom to the sheet body (or padding-bottom: calc(32px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))), the bottomnav, and the actionbar; add viewport-fit=cover note where the shell is documented. Headless verification limit is acceptable, but the CSS must be present.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.js:253 — label.textContent='Saving' during load; html:156 — loading button has no leading icon (spinner is a trailing span); live: btn has no aria-busy at any point (hasAriaBusy:false, duringLoading_ariaBusy:null); button-system.md:31 claims 'spinner replaces the icon slot, label persists'; component-contracts.md:15 claims 'loading announced via aria-busy'
findings.criterion: Loading state: label preserved, icon slot replaced by visible spinner, repeated activation disabled; docs contract
findings.finding: The loading state works (spinner + disabled + guard) but changes the label instead of preserving it, has no icon slot for the spinner to replace, and omits the promised aria-busy announcement.
findings.recommendation: Keep the label constant ('Save'), include a leading 20px icon slot that swaps to the spinner on loading, set aria-busy=true during the request (and aria-live announcement via the snackbar afterwards is already fine).

findings.evidence: Live: chip.getAttribute('aria-pressed') = null; nav active item aria-current = null; [data-seg] has no role=radiogroup and ArrowRight does nothing (active stays 'Month', focus stays on 'Day'); contract claims at component-contracts.md:37 (aria-pressed), :48 (radiogroup + arrow keys), :85 (aria-current)
findings.criterion: Keyboard/focus contracts in component-contracts.md §3, §4, §8; run authority keyboard rules (controls operable — satisfied via Tab+Enter, but semantics are contractual)
findings.finding: Three documented ARIA behaviors are not implemented: chip aria-pressed, nav aria-current, and segmented radiogroup semantics with arrow-key movement. All controls remain reachable/operable by keyboard, so this is a contract-fulfillment gap rather than an operability failure.
findings.recommendation: Toggle aria-pressed on chips; set aria-current='page' (or 'true') on the active nav item; give segmented controls role=radiogroup + roving tabindex with Left/Right (mirrored in RTL) arrow handling.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.css:304-311 — underline variant active state is a per-button border-bottom color swap (instant); source SegmentedControl.jsx:79-85 uses a shared absolutely-positioned indicator with transition-all 300ms ease-out; component-contracts.md:47 claims 'underline slides same'
findings.criterion: Segmented underline variant: sliding indicator (contract §4; source behavior)
findings.finding: The underline variant does not slide — the indicator is per-button and swaps instantly, diverging from the source's shared sliding indicator and the contract's 'underline slides same' claim.
findings.recommendation: Mirror the source: one absolutely-positioned 4px indicator under the row, positioned with inset-inline-start/width computed like the pill thumb, transitioning at the (normalized) 200ms token.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.html:221-222 — static .is-error input (value '12,4o0') + message below the field, no interaction; the only interactive recovery is the surface error panel's retry (html:539-542, js:278-293) which has no input to preserve; empty-loading-error-states.md:23 claims field errors are 'correctable in place'
findings.criterion: Required behavior G: error recovery NEAR the failed control preserving user input
findings.finding: Field-level error display exists near the control, but there is no in-place recovery interaction demonstrating input preservation (the erroneous value is a frozen demo string; no fix/re-submit path).
findings.recommendation: Make the invalid amount demo live: validate on input, show the message under the field, keep the user's typed value editable, and let a corrected value clear the error without losing focus or content.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.css:260 — .chip { transition: all var(--motion-fast) var(--ease-standard) }
findings.criterion: motion-interaction.md:5 own principle: 'Every transition moves one property'
findings.finding: Chips transition 'all', which can animate unintended properties (e.g. layout-affecting ones) and violates the package's one-property-per-transition principle.
findings.recommendation: Restrict to 'background-color, color, border-color, transform'.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.css:172-175 — .spinner uses fixed white borders (rgba(255,255,255,.35) + #FFFFFF top); button-system.md:31 claims 'currentColor'

findings.recommendation: Use currentColor with a translucent track (border-color: color-mix or rgba via opacity) so the component ports across variants.

findings.evidence: component-gallery.html:158-161 — the static 'Quiet completion' state strip is a btn-complete 'Saved' button with no check icon; the check only appears in the loading demo cycle (html:156)

findings.evidence: No body/document overflow lock anywhere in component-gallery.js; page behind the sheet remains scrollable (overlays are position:absolute inside the frame); overlay-system.md:20 claims 'body scroll locked while open'; source BottomSheet.jsx:33 does lock it

findings.evidence: verification-report.md:54-58 — dialog/snackbar close and auto-dismiss marked PASS via hidden-attribute assertions; live rendering contradicts the visual outcome (S3-01/S3-02); motion was never asserted
findings.criterion: Evidence-based completion claim (verification-report §2)
findings.finding: The prior run's browser verification checked state attributes, not rendered visibility or motion, so two blockers and the entire missing motion layer passed unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: For the repair run: assert closes with getBoundingClientRect/offsetParent visibility and assert computed transition/animation values (transitionDuration != 0s where motion is claimed).

top_5: S3-01/S3-02 (blockers): dialog and snackbar never visually close — author display:flex overrides the [hidden] attribute; once opened they stay rendered on screen (dialog 324×194 with live buttons after Escape; snackbar persists after its 5s timer), and the prior verification passed them on attribute checks only.

S3-04 (major): every overlay motion claim (sheet 340ms slide, scrim 200ms fade, dialog scaleIn 200ms, snackbar 300ms slide+fade + 250ms exit, menu 200ms fade/scale) is documented-but-not-implemented — keyframes exist in design-tokens.css but are referenced nowhere; all overlays toggle instantly.

S3-03 (major): focus restore to the trigger is broken — openTrigger is nulled by overlayClose() inside openOverlay(); sheet close drops focus to BODY, dialog close leaves it on the hidden dialog's Cancel.

S3-05 (major): timing tokens diverge from the required system — press 120 vs 80ms, fast 200 vs 120ms, base 300 vs 200ms, sheet 340 vs 240ms; sheet-out/dialog-in/dialog-out tokens do not exist (all four current values are faithful source inheritances).

S3-06..S3-11 (majors): the required interaction layer is missing — no sheet drag-to-dismiss/snap points, no staged filter sheet with Apply/Reset/Cancel, no state-restoring undo, no quick-action rail with snap + next-item cue, no local row insert/remove feedback (ghostOut unused), no progress bar with immediate final numbers.
